expectations.text: Points to NIST IR 8576, the Transit Cybersecurity Framework Community Profile, finalized August 2026
expectations.evidence: NIST IR 8576 - Transit Cybersecurity Framework Community Profile was finalized on August 5, 2026

expectations.text: Describes it as a CSF 2.0 Community Profile for US transit agencies (bus, subway, commuter rail)
expectations.evidence: a CSF 2.0 Community Profile built specifically for U.S. transit agencies operating bus, subway/rail, and commuter rail systems

expectations.text: Notes its operational technology / cyber-physical systems emphasis
expectations.evidence: operational-technology (OT) realities common to transit operators - think fare collection systems, positive train control / signaling, SCADA

expectations.text: States it complements rather than replaces the agency's existing cybersecurity program
expectations.evidence: It complements, not replaces, your existing program.

expectations.text: Explains what a Community Profile is: a sector-tailored baseline of CSF outcomes/priorities usable as a starting point or prioritization aid
expectations.evidence: a pre-built Target Profile developed by and for a specific sector, so that individual organizations don't have to build a target state from scratch
